title: Statehood
description: Utah achieved statehood 1896 (45th). The road to statehood ran through territorial government, population thresholds, and a congressional enabling act — the standard American path. title: Capital: Salt Lake City
d: Salt Lake City is the capital of Utah.

description: Salt Lake City has been the seat of Utah government, home to the capitol building, the supreme court, and the legislature.
